item.title: Top 2nd Weeks of All Time at Hindi Box Office: Dhurandhar takes No. 1 spot with huge margin
item.description: Dhurandhar has set a new benchmark for the biggest second weekend of all time for a Hindi film, surpassing Allu Arjun's Pushpa 2 by a huge margin of Rs. 63.50 crore. The spy action drama collected Rs. 242 crore in its second week, with Rs. 22 crore coming in on the second Thursday. Interestingly, no other film could ever cross the Rs. 200 crore net mark in the second week.
